name: Ray Brothers Inc
old_description: With several metal roof profiles, custom fabrication capabilities, and offering only the industries best prefinished paint systems let Ray Bros., Inc. assist you on planning your next metal roof and wall system project.
about:
Ray Brothers Inc., operating as Ray Bros., Inc., is an architectural sheet metal fabricator based in New Orleans, Louisiana. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources.

The firm produces structural and architectural metal panels—including its MT240, M100, and 200 series—along with framing products and custom fabrications. Its shop offers waterjet cutting, press forming, and custom fabrication services, and it also provides commercial general contracting, material sales, and project planning, estimating, and design. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

Ray Bros. serves commercial, institutional, and government construction markets. Completed projects include re-roofing the Nashville Avenue Terminal at the Port of New Orleans, retro-framing the Plaquemines Parish Council Building, copper roofing for the Old Algiers Courthouse and Holy Name of Mary Catholic Church, and work on Fifth Ward Elementary, Slidell Government Tower, and the Louisiana Avenue Wharf.

The company emphasizes its prefinished paint systems and value‑saving services such as custom fabrication sizing, waterjet cutting, and integrated project planning as differentiators.
